descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B27 · P2 · 新（部分已知）

失败状态提示不对或不清楚：Encounter 页 Generate 灰着但不说原因（已知 U59）；养老院 Save Note 被打断后提示说「文字被改过」；口述自动恢复后红色「断线」错误还挂着；快速口述转写失败时没有「⚠ 该怎么做」

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-04/S28

思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S08 「引擎路由 × 会话结果 → 哪个引擎写字、记下什么」 Engine route × session outcome → which engine writes the text and what is logged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser.（TFA-94423 AC 1；TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09)）
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model.（UAT TC-23；UAT 3.9；TFA-94423 AC 7）
  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total.（UAT 3.5）
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery.（TFA-94229 R9） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, …（TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 6；TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Hospital pre-round box; E-3 and E-4 also on the Nursing Home Pre-Round box and Encounter Dictate, and E-4 also on Hospital Important Points, encounter notes and 'Start bedside recording'; local aiProvider.transcription = gpt-live (read only)

When Dictate H-01 (E-1…E-3) or H-03 (E-4) while the runner makes the live connection succeed, fail once, fail twice, or drop after speech has flowed

Then E-1 connects: text exact, one prepareSession row (gpt-live-transcribe), no transcribeAudio row. E-2 first connect fails before audio: one quiet retry, then ready, text exact. E-3 both fail: a clear message within about 31 s, field unchanged, no silent switch to another engine, nothing queued offline. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Expected cells from TFA-94745 AC 3 / AC 4 and Quinn's 2026-10-05 comment (T9: one retry; a dropped session's recording transcribed once with whisper-1; error only if that fails), TFA-94423 AC 1 and AC 7, UAT 3.5 (retry, then a clear message, never waiting with nothing) and TFA-94229 R9 (no dictated fact lost). …

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-dictation（口述 AI 检查）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-94423 ready for qa；TFA-94229 in progress

养老院口述中途断线、自动恢复后字已经在框里了，红色的「Live dictation disconnected」错误还一直挂着，医生会以为丢了内容。

In Nursing Home, after a dropped dictation is recovered automatically and the words are in the box, the red 'Live dictation disconnected' error stays on screen, so the physician thinks something was lost.

依据：allure-results/e9cc8bbb…: 7/9 decided cells pass. In NH Pre-Round and NH Encounter, 'Live dictation disconnected. Review the last phrase…' is still on screen 8 s after recovery put the text in the box; Hospital clears it. Code: the NH Pre-Round tab passes no onError, so ClientErrorBanner is never cleared, and recover() does not clear captureError. This breaks Quinn's 2026-10-05 TFA-94745 rule (error only if recovery fails). TC-23 Q16 is related. Not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-dictation。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：aicheck-dictation。

Tickets: TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane aicheck-dictation：aicheck-dictation/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（aicheck-dictation/plan.json，automatable: partly）：scripted far end + fault injection in the page: E-1 none; E-2 first realtime/calls POST rejected; E-3 both rejected (message within ~31 s, field unchanged, no transcribeAudio); E-4 the app's own 'oai-events' channel closed after the first sentence (recovery via transcribeAudio answered at the socket). Count prepareSession rows from diagnostics:list and transcribeAudio calls at the socket. E-5 not run (needs aiProvider:_set, forbidden). E-6 from ai_disclosure rows. Since the review fix prepareSession is stubbed at the socket: E-1/E-2/E-4 count the app's prepareSession calls there (the server writes no row), the configured route comes from aiProvider:_current, and E-6 is not decided in S08 (no transcribe rows); the real rows are in S21/S24. One retry per cell when the local backend timed out or was unreachable. — Retry/message/recovery cells are the app's own logic and run here; 'text exact' in E-1/E-2 and the whisper-1 fidelity in E-4 need the live engine (gated). E-5 is forbidden by CLAUDE.md.

Detail:

Scripted far end and scripted recovery: decides the app's retry, message, single-session and recovery behaviour. 7/9 decided cells pass; failing: E-4 nursing-home Pre-Round: channel closed after 'Creatinine 1.8, up from 1.2.' → recovered once, no second session, no error once recovered (field "Creatinine 1.8, up from 1.2."; first sentence ×1; transcribeAudio calls 1; prepareSession calls 1 (stub); still 'Listening…' false; messages when the text landed ["Live dictation disconnected."], 8 s later ["Live dictation disconnected."]); E-4 nursing-home Encounter: channel closed after 'Creatinine 1.8, up from 1.2.' → recovered once, no second session, no error once recovered (field "Creatinine 1.8, up from 1.2."; first sentence ×1; transcribeAudio calls 1; prepareSession calls 1 (stub); still 'Listening…' false; messages when the text landed ["Live dictation disconnected."], 8 s later ["Live dictation disconnected."]); not decided here: E-1/E-2 'text exact' and the E-4 whisper-1 transcript need the live engine (laneB-preconditions: key OK); E-4 on Hospital encounter notes and 'Start bedside recording' not built in this pass; E-5 forbidden prepareSession: 13 call(s), 13 stubbed at the socket, 0 real OpenAI mint(s) with …PUMA. Build e02167f; aiProvider:_current {"model":"us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0","provider":"bedrock","transcription":"gpt-live","visionModel":"gemini-2.5-flash","visionProvider":"vertex"}.

产品问题：nursing-home Pre-Round, nursing-home Encounter: when a live dictation drops mid-take and the kept recording is recovered automatically, the words land in the box but the red error 'Live dictation disconnected. Review the last phrase before continuing.' stays on screen (still there 8 s after the text landed). Breaks TFA-94745 AC 4 / Quinn's 2026-10-05 rule (show an error only if recovery fails) — S08 E-4. Code read (reviewer): the NH Pre-Round tab passes no onError, so the global ClientErrorBanner shows it and never clears it; useEncounterDictation's captureError is not cleared by recover().

证据：附了 10 个；没附 1 个：

  • aicheck-dictation/artifacts/20261014-fix-client-stub/pw/tc23-client-TC-23-S08-engi-51095-ome-retry-message-recovery--dictation/trace.zip — .zip 文件不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
